title: Head of Secretary Division
place: PUMA (President University Major Association) Information Systems 2025
intro: As the Head of Secretary Division of PUMA IS 2025, I was responsible for leading and supervising a team of two secretarial members.
jobdesk: Led and supervised a team of 2 secretarial members in completing organizational tasks and improving administrative skills.
Assisted team members in completing assignments and monitored their progress to ensure task completion.
Provided guidance in secretarial and administrative work, including document preparation and organizational coordination.
Created standard letter templates for organizational proposals, reporting, and official correspondence.
Prepared and presented monthly reports related to division performance and organizational improvements.
Served as Secretary for the IStrumental 2024 event to support event administration and documentation.
